tagline: Clean alpine skincare, made in Tyrol.
about: Alpenglow was founded in 2017 in Innsbruck, Austria. Today a team of 34 formulates, fills and ships our creams from our own workshop. We sell through our webshop and 120 pharmacies.

tagline: Small-batch coffee from the west coast of Ireland.
about: We're 18 people roasting specialty coffee in Galway since 2015. Subscriptions ship every Monday from our online shop.
Hollow Oak designs furniture in Aarhus, Denmark. With around 140 employees across design, production and logistics, we deliver to 14 countries from our web store.
Vellum & Thread is a studio of nine makers in Manchester, United Kingdom, selling small-batch clothing online and at weekend markets.
From a kitchen table in 2014 to a team of 52 in Eindhoven: Pawsome Provisions bakes natural dog treats sold in our webshop and in 300 pet stores across the Benelux.
Brightside GmbH, headquartered in Munich, employs more than 250 people (260 at the last count) and sells vitamins and supplements online and through drugstores in Germany.

tagline: Branding and packaging design for food brands.
about: Marigold is a 14-person branding agency in Ghent, Belgium. We design packaging for food and drink start-ups and manage their print production.

tagline: Your online print shop for boxes and labels.
about: Printhaus Direkt in Stuttgart prints folding cartons, mailer boxes and labels for 4,000 customers a year with a team of 85.
Kinfolk Candle Co. is a family business of six in Portland, Oregon, USA. We pour every candle by hand and ship across the US from our online shop.
Founded in 2019, Sunny Side employs 41 people at our bakery in Bordeaux, France. You can find our granola in Monoprix and on our webshop.
North Loom AB (Stockholm, Sweden) has grown to roughly 320 colleagues, with flagship stores in five cities and an online store shipping worldwide.
Verde Botanicals is an organic hair care brand from Bologna, Italy. Our 23-strong team sells online and to salons.
ByteForge Labs builds route-planning software in Warsaw, Poland, with a team of 60 engineers and designers.

tagline: Wooden toys that last for generations.
about: Little Acorn designs wooden toys in Haarlem, the Netherlands. 27 people, one workshop, and a webshop that ships across Europe.
Ferment & Co. brews kombucha in Bristol, UK. We are a team of 12 and sell through our website, cafés and farm shops.
Glow Theory is a Barcelona make-up brand. About 75 employees, sold online and in 400 stores in Spain and Portugal.
Harbor Health is a physiotherapy clinic in Rotterdam with 45 therapists and staff. We do not sell products.
Wildroot is eight friends blending herbal teas in Brno, Czech Republic, and shipping them from our e-shop.
Atlas Outdoor Gear, Hamburg, employs over 600 people (610) in design, retail and logistics. Our products are sold in 30 countries and online.
Crumb Collective runs two bakeries in Antwerp, Belgium, with 19 bakers. We deliver pastry boxes ordered online.
Lumen Learning Lab teaches coding to teenagers in Utrecht. Our 30 teachers run after-school courses.
Saltwater was started in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2020. Our team of 16 turns recycled fishing nets into swimwear sold on our webshop.
Oak & Honey distils gin in Edinburgh, Scotland. 110 people work at our distillery, visitor centre and online shop.
Pure Pet Spa is a grooming salon in Utrecht run by four groomers.
Nimbus Audio designs headphones in Helsinki, Finland. Our 95 employees ship to customers worldwide from our online store.
Bloom Box is a Berlin flower subscription with 38 florists and drivers. We deliver 6,000 boxes a month.
Terra Ceramica is a workshop of 11 potters near Florence, Italy, selling tableware online and to restaurants.
